title: Staged-combustion engine
description: The turbine gas is not thrown away. Two preburners drive the pumps, and their exhaust flows on into the main chamber and burns there. That allows very high pressure and the best efficiency of any chemical engine.

reference.engine: Aerojet Rocketdyne RS-25 (Space Shuttle Main Engine, now on the Space Launch System)

derived.note: throat from exit diameter and expansion ratio

reference.note: Outer dimensions match the published figures. The powerhead layout is simplified: the low-pressure boost pumps are left out and the coolant routing is reduced to one path.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale: display speed = 0.22 * v^0.32 (m/s).

liquids_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

turbine_gas_ms.note: nominal values, not from engine data

parts.title: Thrust mount
parts.description: Bolts the engine to the vehicle and carries the thrust load into the structure.

parts.title: Gimbal joint
parts.description: Two-axis universal joint. Lets the whole engine swivel so the thrust vector can steer the vehicle.

parts.title: Thrust adapter
parts.description: Short cone that transfers thrust from the powerhead up into the gimbal.

parts.title: Dome bolts
parts.description: Clamp the oxidizer dome onto the hot-gas manifold.

parts.title: Oxidizer dome
parts.description: Feeds liquid oxygen from the pump into the tops of the injector posts.

parts.title: Hot-gas manifold
parts.description: The heart of the cycle. It collects the hydrogen-rich gas leaving both turbines and leads it into the main injector, so nothing is dumped overboard.

parts.title: Main injector
parts.description: Liquid oxygen runs down the posts while the hot hydrogen-rich gas flows around them. The two meet and burn at the injector face.

parts.title: Chamber liner
parts.description: Copper-alloy inner wall. Liquid hydrogen runs through the channels milled into its outside and keeps it from melting.

parts.title: Coolant outlet manifold
parts.description: Collects the hydrogen after it has cooled the nozzle and chamber, and sends it on to the two preburners.

parts.title: Chamber jacket
parts.description: Outer shell that closes the coolant channels and holds the chamber pressure, about 206 bar.

parts.title: Nozzle joint bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle to the chamber exit flange.

parts.title: Nozzle
parts.description: Expands the exhaust to about 4 km/s. Its wall is cooled by liquid hydrogen, and the bands around it keep it stiff.

parts.title: Coolant inlet manifold
parts.description: Ring at the nozzle exit. High-pressure hydrogen from the pump enters here and spreads into the wall.

parts.title: Fuel preburner
parts.description: Burns most of the hydrogen with a little oxygen. The gas is hydrogen-rich and only moderately hot, which the turbine below it can survive.

parts.title: Oxidizer preburner
parts.description: A second, smaller preburner. It also runs hydrogen-rich and drives the oxygen pump's turbine.

parts.title: Fuel pump turbine
parts.description: The preburner gas spins this turbine, which drives the hydrogen pump. The gas then flows on to the hot-gas manifold.

parts.title: Oxidizer pump turbine
parts.description: Driven by the oxidizer preburner. Its exhaust also flows on to the hot-gas manifold.

parts.title: High-pressure fuel pump
parts.description: Three centrifugal stages raise the liquid hydrogen to about 430 bar. On the RS-25 this pump absorbs about 53,000 kW.

parts.title: High-pressure oxidizer pump
parts.description: Raises the liquid oxygen to about 500 bar. On the RS-25 it absorbs about 17,000 kW.

parts.title: Fuel turbopump rotor
parts.description: One shaft with two turbine wheels at the top and three pump impellers below.

parts.title: Oxidizer turbopump rotor
parts.description: One shaft with two turbine wheels at the top and the pump impeller below.

parts.title: Main fuel valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure hydrogen to the cooling circuit.

parts.title: Main oxidizer valve
parts.description: Opens to send high-pressure oxygen to the dome and the preburners.

parts.title: Coolant feed line
parts.description: Carries hydrogen from the pump down the outside of the nozzle to the inlet manifold at its exit.

parts.title: High-pressure oxidizer line
parts.description: Carries liquid oxygen from the main valve to the dome.

parts.title: Preburner fuel lines
parts.description: Carry the warmed hydrogen from the coolant outlet manifold to both preburners.

parts.title: Preburner oxidizer lines
parts.description: Send a small share of the oxygen to each preburner.

parts.title: Gimbal actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine. The two actuators sit 90 degrees apart.

parts.title: Gimbal actuator
parts.description: Linear actuator that tilts the engine. The two actuators sit 90 degrees apart.

parts.title: Fuel feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid hydrogen from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Oxidizer feed line
parts.description: Low-pressure liquid oxygen from the tank to the pump inlet.

parts.title: Fuel tank
parts.description: Liquid hydrogen. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.

parts.title: Oxidizer tank
parts.description: Liquid oxygen. Only lightly pressurised, because the pumps do the work. Shown schematically, not to scale.
